constraints: No API authentication or RBAC ownership change
No Root Authority or production approval change
No duplicate schema-application logic across PostgreSQL workflows
One canonical migration runner owns PostgreSQL migration execution
Applied migration checksum or name drift must fail closed
Concurrent migration writers must be rejected by PostgreSQL advisory lock
Migration and ledger record must commit atomically for supported transactional migrations
Non-transactional migrations require an explicit future contract and fail closed until then
Tenant context absence must expose zero tenant rows for non-bypass runtime roles
Cross-tenant writes must be denied by PostgreSQL RLS
Fresh and upgraded databases must converge to one tenant-aware primary/unique constraint set
CI PostgreSQL server and client major versions must remain compatible
GitHub Actions billing lock remains BLOCKED_EXTERNAL and cannot be treated as code PASS/FAIL
Git commit cadence is one batched commit per local calendar day unless emergency rollback is required
Every daily commit must refresh latest main and exact target-file status immediately before creation
